Day 27: Pause announced amid ongoing strikes

  • Diplomacy / Pause: US announced a second pause on strikes targeting Iranian energy infrastructure. 10-day pause until Apr 6, 2026 8:00 PM ET. US says Iran requested talks. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Tactical note: First pause (5 days from Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. New pause is fragile.
  • Air campaign: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian military and infrastructure continue this week.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah conducts daily missile/rocket attacks into northern Israel. Persistent exchanges continue.
  • Counterstrikes: Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas continue missile/drone launches into Israel. Interception systems remain active.
  • Hormuz: Iran allows passage for Russia, India, China while blocking others. Limits shock for those states; complicates coalition maritime options.
  • International moves: Pakistan-led mediation open. No major new deployments reported in the last 30 minutes.
  • 🟢 Good News: A formal pause window exists and Pakistan mediation provides a diplomatic channel.

Threat assessment: Escalating — pause fragile; reciprocal strikes continue.
